table_description: Product dimension table containing over 500,000 item records. Each row describes one product version (items are slowly changing — a price change creates a new row with a new REC_START_DATE). Contains a rich product hierarchy: category > class > brand > manufacturer, plus size, color, units, and pricing.
use_cases: Product category and brand performance analysis
Price elasticity analysis (list price vs sales price)
Margin analysis using wholesale cost vs selling price
Product color and size preference analysis
Top selling items by revenue, quantity, or profit
data_quality_notes: ITEM is a slowly changing dimension (SCD Type 2) — one item can have multiple rows with different I_REC_START_DATE and I_REC_END_DATE. To get current items: WHERE I_REC_END_DATE IS NULL or use the most recent record.
I_CATEGORY values include: 'Women', 'Men', 'Children', 'Shoes', 'Music', 'Jewelry', 'Sports', 'Books', 'Home', 'Electronics' — these are the top-level product groupings.
I_CLASS is the subcategory under I_CATEGORY.
I_BRAND is the brand name; I_BRAND_ID is the numeric brand ID.
I_CURRENT_PRICE is the current retail price. I_WHOLESALE_COST is the cost to the retailer.
Gross margin per item = (I_CURRENT_PRICE - I_WHOLESALE_COST) / I_CURRENT_PRICE.

table_columns.name: I_ITEM_SK
table_columns.description: Surrogate primary key. Used in all sales and inventory fact tables.

table_columns.name: I_ITEM_ID
table_columns.description: Business key for the item. Same item across SCD versions shares I_ITEM_ID.

table_columns.name: I_REC_START_DATE
table_columns.description: When this version of the item record became active (SCD Type 2).

table_columns.name: I_REC_END_DATE
table_columns.description: When this item version expired. NULL means currently active.

table_columns.name: I_CURRENT_PRICE
table_columns.description: Current retail price. Use for margin analysis.

table_columns.name: I_WHOLESALE_COST
table_columns.description: Retailer's cost to stock this item. Gross margin = I_CURRENT_PRICE - I_WHOLESALE_COST.

table_columns.name: I_CATEGORY
table_columns.description: Top-level product category: Women, Men, Children, Shoes, Music, Jewelry, Sports, Books, Home, Electronics.

table_columns.name: I_SIZE
table_columns.description: Product size: small, medium, large, extra large, N/A, petite, etc.

table_columns.name: I_UNITS
table_columns.description: Unit of measure: Each, Dozen, Pound, Ounce, etc.

table_columns.name: I_MANAGER_ID
table_columns.description: Category manager ID responsible for this item.
